title: Muqabala
desc: Two feared gangsters declare a truce and strike up an unlikely friendship, but their hard-won peace shatters when both fall for the same woman and refuse to let love go.

title: Saathi
desc: Suraj and Amar witness their father's murder. Later, Suraj embraces crime while Amar resists, leading to conflict between brothers torn apart by choices, loyalty, and vengeance.

title: Phool Aur Kante
desc: Ajay, the son of a crime boss, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his father. Forced into the underworld, he must confront danger and fight to save his family.

title: Pardes
desc: Kishorilal chooses Ganga for his NRI son. But Ganga shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son, leading to a conflict between duty and love.

title: Cheeni Kum
desc: Buddhadev, a 64-year-old chef, falls for Nina, 34. Their future is shaken when he learns her father is six years younger than him, casting doubt on their relationship.

title: Mercury
desc: Five friends reunite to a reunion with their deformed friend.

title: Socha Na Tha
desc: Viren cant imagine having an arranged marriage. His parents want him to meet Aditi. They refuse to get married but stay friends. Will Cupid strike and change their minds?

title: Saaransh
desc: A retired teacher and his wife struggle with grief after losing their only son to a tragic mugging. Slowly, they learn to find peace, holding on to memories and each other.

title: Hathkadi
desc: ACP Suraj, an honest cop, vows revenge after his innocent brother is killed. But when he's framed for murder and jailed, his fight for justice takes a shocking turn.

title: Tapasya
desc: Indu, eldest daughter of a sick man, falls for her father's doctor. But her lover's mother demands she abandon her family and place her in-laws above all else.

title: Baaghi
desc: Defiant Saajan abandons his home for Kaajal, the woman he loves, trapped under Dhanraj's control in a brothel. Shunned by his family, the lovers flee to escape Dhanraj's wrath.

title: Shaurya
desc: Captain Javed Khan is accused of murdering his commanding officer, Major Rathod. Choosing silence to protect the honour of his uniform, he risks his career and freedom.

title: Army
desc: After army officer Arjun is brutally killed by gangster Naagraj, his wife Geeta vows revenge and forms a group of determined young men to bring Naagraj down.

title: Yeh Vaada Raha
desc: Vikram's mother rejects Sunita for her modest background. Defying family, they elope, but a tragic accident shatters their dreams and tears them apart forever.
